correctness.rationale: The strict three-normal illumination criterion at each of 60 truncated vertices follows from 12 icosahedral pentagon normals and 20 triangle-face normals. An independent exact arithmetic implementation rebuilt 12 vertices, 30 edges, 20 faces and 32 normals in Z[phi], enumerated 16 great circles and all 152 generic sign chambers with distribution 132 hitting 20 and 20 hitting 21; the 20 negative face directions each hit 21 vertices and hit each vertex exactly seven times. Therefore the sharp 60/21 lower bound and 20*(1/7) cover agree; boundary nongeneric directions cannot outperform nearby generic ones by strict inequalities. Independent computation verifies critical certificate rather than trusting a VERIFY_OK log.
